teaser: Joining Algarve Evolution: The Cyber Boardroom takes the startup membership and shares its workflows and technology, all open source.
core_idea: The Cyber Boardroom joins Algarve Evolution on its Start membership, with the editor in conversation with its executive director; what it brings is not a priced service but what it already does, workflows and technology that are all open source, matched to Algarve Evolution's three pillars of education, startups and SMEs, and the ecosystem; what it gets is a community of founders with real problems, the best test of whether any of it is useful.

nodes.label: The Start membership
nodes.summary: €150 a year, for startups from idea to growth.

nodes.label: Share, not sell
nodes.summary: Workflows and technology, all open source, usable without us.

nodes.label: Education
nodes.summary: The checklist loop, explorer coding, the memo-to-release pipeline, buildathon follow-ups.

nodes.label: Startups and SMEs
nodes.summary: Villager services, the inbox recipe, behaviour policies and SHarness, websites you own.

nodes.label: The ecosystem
nodes.summary: A newsroom with standards, vaults and graphs for the community map, open-source tools, Web Summit.

nodes.label: A community with real problems
nodes.summary: The best test of whether it is useful.
